title: Three days without power · 16:9
style: Style: clean 2D cartoon illustration like a modern animated YouTube story: thin smooth dark outlines, flat muted colours with soft shading, detailed painted backgrounds, cinematic lighting. Palette: muted teal-grey, sage green, sand and warm ochre by day; deep indigo with warm lamp pools at night. Calm and a little eerie, never cute or neon.

character.A: THE MAIN CHARACTER (identical in every image): a simple stick-figure man, a big perfectly round white head with a thin black outline, two small black dot eyes, short thin eyebrows, a small mouth line, no nose and no ears; short messy black hair under a mustard-yellow ribbed knit beanie with a folded cuff; a body of thin single black lines; white cartoon gloved hands; small dark grey sneakers.

designs.APARTMENT: THE APARTMENT (same in every image): dark green front door with a brass peephole and a chain lock; kitchen with sage-green cabinets, a white enamel sink, terracotta square tiles and an old white fridge; living room with a mustard two-seat sofa, a round wooden table, an old boxy TV and dusty olive-green curtains; parquet floor, pale sage walls.

rules.add: Keep the main character exactly as in the reference: thin single-line stick limbs, the big plain round white head with tiny dot eyes, the mustard beanie, white gloved hands.
Keep it readable: deep indigo rather than pure black, a faint cool glow so the room and the character can still be seen.
Any other person is the same simple stick-figure style, described in full here every time.

shots.p: A character design sheet of the main character: front view standing, three-quarter view walking, side view, and a close-up of the head looking worried, on a plain warm-grey background.
A wide cutaway of his small fourth-floor APARTMENT seen from the front like a dollhouse, the main character standing in the living room, soft morning light.

Bedroom at dawn, cold blue light through the curtains. The main character sits bolt upright in his single bed under a grey-blue blanket, eyes wide, his phone glowing on the bedside table next to a lamp.
Close-up: the main character's white gloved hand holding a smartphone whose screen glows red with a warning-triangle icon (no readable text); the dim APARTMENT living room behind, out of focus.
Extreme close-up: clear water streaming from a chrome kitchen tap into a plastic bottle held by a white cartoon gloved hand, bubbles and splashes, terracotta tiles blurred behind, soft morning light.
The APARTMENT kitchen: a long row of filled water bottles of different sizes on the parquet floor; the main character stands beside them, pointing down and counting, worried eyebrows.

Top-down view of the round wooden table covered with food that keeps without a fridge: a bag of rice, a box of oats, pasta, a jar of peanut butter, cans of beans and soup, crackers, sardine tins; warm light.
NIGHT in the APARTMENT living room, the last purple dusk in the window; the main character reaches to switch off the table lamp; deep indigo shadows, the room still readable.

shots.for: a second pose of the same shot
shots.p: The lamp is now off; he stands still in the dark, listening, eyes turned toward the ceiling.
